== C10 new-citation ratchet (the gate) ==
Mechanism: no NEW citation may point at a volatile path (/tmp, /private/tmp, absolute-outside-tree, untracked/). New-vs-existing is decided MECHANICALLY by the pre-commit diff — claimlint runs `git diff --cached --unified=0` (the hook stages before invoking claimlint) and scans only ADDED (+) lines of prose docs (docs/*.md + AGENTS.md) with the same volatileClassOf classifier C10 uses. An unchanged (context) line never appears in the diff, so the 1,375 existing volatile citations are grandfathered (reported, never re-flagged) and a newly-added one fails. The count folds into the C2 summary number (dead links + newly-added volatile), which the pre-commit hook already gates at floor 0, so no hook edit was needed and the hook's existing regression() blocks the commit. Red-then-green verified: a seeded diff line `+see `/tmp/nope.log`` reports C10-NEW total 1 and exit 1; the null control (a context line carrying the same path) reports 0.
